sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price*il.quantity) AS value FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id=il.track_id JOIN public.album a ON t.album_id=a.album_id JOIN public.artist ar ON a.artist_id=ar.artist_id WHERE i.invoice_date>=DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2023-01-01' AND ar.name='Metallica'
